KNOW #4 📚 Spread Kya Hai?
Trade kholte hi loss me kyun dikhti hai?
• Kyunki har price ke do rate hote hain, buy ka aur sell ka.
• In dono ka farak spread hai. Yahi broker ki fees hai.
• News ke time aur raat ko rollover pe spread kai guna badh jaata hai.
Tip: news se theek pehle entry mat lo.
Aur seekhna hai to follow karo. Trade setups ke liye Telegram join karo — link bio me 🕷️
